metadata_1.title: Careers
metadata_1.description: Open roles at Three Acts — a DX engineer and a design-system engineer — and how to apply.

sections_2.heading: Working here
sections_2.body: We build and maintain the template itself — everyone here reads support email, ships template updates and helps agency partners get unstuck, whatever's on their job title.

sections_2.heading: DX engineer
sections_2.body: Full-time, remote. You'll work on the CLI, the collection registry tooling and the schema migration scripts — the parts of Three Acts that make forking the template for a new client fast instead of fiddly. Comfortable in TypeScript across a monorepo; you care about error messages and docs as much as code.

sections_2.heading: Design-system engineer
sections_2.body: Full-time, remote. You'll own the component kit in apps/web/src/components/ui and apps/cms — tokens, primitives, accessibility, and keeping the two themes (public site, editorial workspace) consistent without merging them. A strong eye for type, spacing and interaction detail.

sections_2.heading: How to apply
sections_2.body: Send a short note about yourself and a CV or portfolio to {{site.email}} with the role name in the subject line. No cover letter template needed — just tell us why you want to work on this, and why here.

careers.lede_5: We're a small team building the template full-time — see what's open below.
